links.outcome: Readability of chatbot answers to patient PET/CT questions (FRE, GFI, FKRGL)
links.effect: Readability scores differed significantly between ChatGPT-4 and Gemini (p<0.001); Gemini responses were shorter and more readable, but the authors conclude chatbot information cannot be easily read by the public.
links.quote: However, the information provided by AI-chatbots cannot be easily read by the public.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the reliability and readability of ChatGPT-4 and Google Gemini responses to simulated patient questions about PET/CT scans without testing an organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
